title: Salmon en Papillote with Syrian Pilaf
description: A French-inspired dish featuring salmon baked in parchment paper with a side of flavorful Syrian pilaf. This recipe showcases the delicate flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Place a salmon fillet in the center of a large piece of parchment paper.
Add a tablespoon of olive oil, a tablespoon of lemon juice, and a sprinkle of thyme on top of the salmon.
Fold the parchment paper to form a packet, making sure the edges are sealed.
Repeat with the remaining salmon fillets.
Bake the salmon packets in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the salmon is baking, prepare the Syrian pilaf according to package instructions.
To serve, place a salmon packet on a plate and serve with a side of Syrian pilaf and roasted yellow bell peppers.
